entries.title: The spark shows everything that reaches a crewmate
entries.body: The spark from your first mate now flies for every action that reaches a crewmate, including a stop, a merge, a discard and a change to its task. A message that waits for its account flies when the crewmate reads it. A crewmate that is leaving goes once its spark lands. Closing a crewmate's card as a duplicate now tells that crewmate.
entries.noPicture: The spark is motion that a still picture cannot show; the change's recording shows it.
